name: @jakeave/honeypot
description: Honeytoken middleware for Deno.serve: hand bots unique fake credentials on trap paths, then log where they get used.

tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check .
tasks.pre-commit: deno task check && deno task test
tasks.pre-push: deno task check && deno task test && deno publish --dry-run --allow-dirty
